title: AMC 10 Practice: Trailing Zeros of Factorials — Do They Double?
description:
AMC 10 practice problem on trailing zeros of factorials, solved by counting factors of five and in base five. (Level 4 of 5)
Does doubling n always double the zeros at the end of n factorial? Not at all! Here's a sneaky AMC 10-style counting puzzle, solved two ways: counting the fives, and thinking in base five.
Pause, try it yourself, then try the triple-it twist at the end.
